principle: PPT pages are poster-like compositions: background layer, text-safe layer, image/object layer, small icon/ornament layer, and final quality gates.

styles.visualGrammar: clean commercial proposal look, soft blue gradient fields, airy whitespace, crisp panels, light shadows
styles.background: soft abstract gradient with open text area, no text, no logo, subtle business texture
styles.imageTreatment: right-side product or document crop, soft shadow, keep full product silhouette when possible
styles.comfyPrompt: clean premium business presentation background, airy blue and white gradient, large empty text-safe area, subtle cards and line details, no words, no logo

styles.visualGrammar: oriental natural premium, warm paper texture, restrained red/olive accents, calm seasonal gift atmosphere
styles.background: rice paper texture, natural warm beige, soft ink-wash depth, clear blank space for Chinese title text
styles.imageTreatment: product hero on right or lower right, preserve packaging integrity, gentle paper-cut or shadow separation
styles.comfyPrompt: oriental natural premium presentation background, warm rice paper texture, olive green and muted red accents, elegant gift/product area, large blank area for text, no words, no logo

styles.visualGrammar: editorial catalog, monochrome restraint, large image crops, strict grid, premium negative space
styles.background: white or very light gray editorial canvas, subtle paper grain, strong grid rhythm, no decorative noise
styles.imageTreatment: large photographic crop, full-bleed edge or strict rectangular crop, generous whitespace
styles.comfyPrompt: minimal monochrome editorial presentation background, white gallery space, subtle paper grain, strict grid, large blank text area, no words, no logo

styles.visualGrammar: Swiss technical report, blue-white structure, precise grids, data modules, engineering confidence
styles.background: light technical grid, blue accents, clean data-panel depth, reserve readable text zone
styles.imageTreatment: screenshots/charts in clean frames, avoid cropping critical labels, use callout lines sparingly
styles.comfyPrompt: blue and white technical presentation background, clean Swiss grid, subtle data panels, precise line accents, large empty text area, no words, no logo

styles.visualGrammar: dark launch keynote, high contrast, glow accents, cinematic depth, sparse confident copy
styles.background: dark premium stage background, cyan glow accents, readable dark-to-clear text zone, no text
styles.imageTreatment: hero object with rim light, strong contrast, keep product contour legible
styles.comfyPrompt: dark premium technology keynote background, cyan glow accents, cinematic depth, clear empty area for text, no words, no logo
